Sure, here are two hints for the given problem:

Hint 1: Consider the nature of one-hot encoding. When you one-hot encode a categorical variable, you create a new binary column for each category. What happens if you include all these columns along with an intercept term?

Hint 2: Think about the concept of linear dependence in the context of one-hot encoded variables. If you have a set of binary columns representing categories, how does including an intercept term affect the rank of the design matrix?
